display.purpose: Hero headlines and brand titles only.

body.purpose: General UI labels and descriptive copy.

label.purpose: Confidence percentages, FPS, latency, and student IDs.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: High-impact CTA for camera launch and student enrollment.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #10b981; color: #090d16; padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #059669; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Telemetry Status Badge
components.description: Real-time engine and confidence score indicator.
components.css: .ds-telemetry-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); color: #34d399; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #10b981; }

narrative.overview: Verity embodies the clarity, restraint, and operational focus of an enterprise biometric terminal. Designed specifically for teachers navigating fast-paced classroom roll calls on handheld mobile devices, the visual language prioritizes immediate cognitive parsing over decorative noise.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted Titanium Surfaces (slate-900/60 with backdrop blur)
Precision Signal Emerald (#10B981) for verification urgency
Bifurcated typography with Geist Sans and Geist Mono telemetry

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Signal Emerald covers ≤10% of any viewport to preserve high-consequence operational urgency.

rules.name: The Telemetry Mono Rule
rules.body: All confidence scores, FPS rates, latency metrics, and student IDs must strictly render in Geist Mono.

rules.name: The Specular Highlight Rule
rules.body: Translucent glass cards must feature an inner 1px specular top rim to simulate precision-milled glass edges.

dos: Do format all machine scores and IDs in Geist Mono.
Do provide active:scale-[0.98] compression on interactive controls.
Do maintain min 44px touch targets on mobile touch devices.
donts: Don't use neon green text for large paragraphs or standard card fills.
Don't use harsh pitch black (#000000); use obsidian slate (#090D16).
Don't use retro pixelated icons in production navigation.
